# Selective Git Commit Commands
# ================================
# This script stages ONLY the dialog feature work, ignoring Unity auto-generated files.
# Run these commands from your repository root.

# ============================================
# STEP 1: Stage Core Dialog System Files
# ============================================
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/Scripts/Dialog/DialogManager.cs"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/Scripts/Dialog/DialogNavigator.cs"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/Dialog Choice.cs"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/Dialog Node.cs"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/Dialog Tree.cs"

# ============================================
# STEP 2: Stage New Dialog Files
# ============================================
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/Scripts/Dialog/DialogEvents.cs"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/Scripts/Dialog/Examples and Guides/CreateLinearDialog.cs"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/Scripts/Dialog/Examples and Guides/DialogTreeFactory.cs"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/Character Content.cs"

# ============================================
# STEP 3: Stage File Rename (NPC Content ? Character Content)
# ============================================
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/NPC Content.cs"  # Stage deletion

# ============================================
# STEP 4: Stage Dialog Asset Data
# ============================================
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/Director First Conversation.asset"
git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/GoToTheSpotlight.asset"

# ============================================
# STEP 5: Stage Documentation Changes
# ============================================
git add ".github/copilot-instructions.md"
git add "Docs/.gitignore-cleanup-commands.txt"

# Stage documentation file moves (deletions from Docs/ - they moved to .github/)
git add "Docs/AI_Instructions.md"
git add "Docs/Class Hierarchy.md"
git add "Docs/Project_Roadmap.md"
git add "Docs/Requirements.md"

# ============================================
# STEP 6: Stage .gitattributes Move
# ============================================
git add ".gitattributes"  # Stage deletion from root (moved to .github/)

# ============================================
# OPTIONAL: Stage PowerPoint Update (if intentional)
# ============================================
# git add "Docs/Dialog System Class Heirarchy.pptx"
# Uncomment above line if you intentionally updated the diagram

# ============================================
# STEP 7: Review Staged Changes
# ============================================
git status

# ============================================
# STEP 8: Commit with Descriptive Message
# ============================================
git commit -m "feat: Enhance dialog system with events, examples, and refactoring

Dialog System Enhancements:
- Enhanced DialogManager with comprehensive validation and debugging
- Refactored DialogNavigator with improved state management
- Extended Dialog Choice with event system support
- Enhanced Dialog Node with auto-advance and parent-child relationships
- Improved Dialog Tree with validation and node management

New Features:
- Added DialogEvents.cs for custom dialog actions and method delegates
- Created CreateLinearDialog.cs utility for quick dialog creation
- Added DialogTreeFactory.cs for dialog tree construction patterns
- Renamed NPC Content ? Character Content for better clarity

Updated Assets:
- Updated Director First Conversation dialog tree
- Updated GoToTheSpotlight dialog data

Documentation:
- Updated .github/copilot-instructions.md with latest patterns
- Reorganized documentation (moved AI_Instructions, Class Hierarchy, etc. to .github/)
- Added .gitignore cleanup commands documentation
- Moved .gitattributes to .github/ folder

This commit represents the Feature/DialogNode-Functionality branch work."

# ============================================
# STEP 9: Verify Commit
# ============================================
git log --oneline -1
git show --stat

# ============================================
# WHAT WE'RE NOT COMMITTING (Intentionally Ignored):
# ============================================
# ? UserSettings/ folder (user-specific Unity editor settings)
# ? UIElementsSchema/ (auto-generated by Unity)
# ? ProjectSettings/ changes (Unity version bump, not feature-related)
# ? Assets/TextMesh Pro/ (needs decision - see below)

# ============================================
# DISCARDING AUTO-GENERATED CHANGES
# ============================================
# To discard UserSettings and ProjectSettings changes:
# git restore UserSettings/
# git restore ProjectSettings/

# To remove UIElementsSchema from tracking (if you want):
# git rm -r --cached UIElementsSchema/
# echo "UIElementsSchema/" >> .gitignore

# ============================================
# TEXTMESH PRO DECISION
# ============================================
# You have Assets/TextMesh Pro/ as untracked.
#
# Option 1: If installed via Package Manager ? Ignore it
#   echo "Assets/TextMesh Pro/" >> .gitignore
#
# Option 2: If manually imported and team needs it ? Commit it
#   git add "Assets/TextMesh Pro/"
#   git commit -m "chore: Add TextMesh Pro package"
#
# Recommendation: Check if it's in Packages/manifest.json instead.
# If TMP is in the manifest, you don't need to commit the Assets/ copy.

# ============================================
# QUICK ONE-LINER (All Core Changes)
# ============================================
# If you want to do all staging in one command:
# git add "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/Scripts/Dialog/*.cs" "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/Scripts/Dialog/Examples and Guides/*.cs" "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/Dialog*.cs" "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/Character Content.cs" "Assets/_Stage of Dreams_/World/*.asset" ".github/copilot-instructions.md" "Docs/.gitignore-cleanup-commands.txt" "Docs/AI_Instructions.md" "Docs/Class Hierarchy.md" "Docs/Project_Roadmap.md" "Docs/Requirements.md" ".gitattributes"

# ============================================
# PUSH TO GITHUB
# ============================================
# After committing, push to your feature branch:
# git push origin Feature/DialogNode-Functionality
